scope: Registered loopback-only Ollama HTTP provider with bounded, schema-aware transport and stable sanitized errors.

candidate.status: Source commit validated and integrated by non-force fast-forward; issue #109 read back OPEN/PARTIAL.

acceptance.provider_neutral_factory_and_capabilitie: PASS - Ollama registers behind AIProvider; it declares text and structured output, while the disabled provider and all default task selections remain unchanged.
acceptance.loopback_only_endpoint_and_proxy_isolati: PASS - only numeric loopback HTTP origins and fixed /api/generate are accepted; proxy environment variables are disabled; remote hosts, DNS names, credentials, paths, query and fragments are rejected.
acceptance.schema_aware_non_streaming_request: PASS - synthetic MockTransport proves model/prompt/stream=false and JSON Schema in Ollama format are sent; router-to-provider structured roundtrip returns a strict typed result.
acceptance.bounded_io_and_sanitized_failures: PASS - request/schema/response/time budgets are bounded; malformed/duplicate response JSON, incomplete outputs, HTTP errors and transport failures expose stable codes without prompt or body echo.
acceptance.actual_model_inference_and_other_provide: NOT_RUN/PARTIAL - all tests use synthetic HTTP responses; no real inference was performed. OpenAI, Azure and other provider adapters remain future work; issue #109 remains OPEN/PARTIAL.

local_validation.environment: Windows isolated worktree; Python 3.12.10; httpx from pinned requirements.lock; no model call made.
local_validation.expected_red: Before provider implementation, all seven new provider tests failed because the provider types were not registered/exported.
not_run: Live Ollama model inference: NOT_RUN; synthetic transport tests establish request/response behavior without nondeterministic model output.
Remote/paid AI providers: NOT_RUN under current policy.
GitHub Actions and hosted review: NOT_RUN under current local-only policy.

limitations: The provider targets only a numeric loopback HTTP origin; no remote API adapter is included in this slice.
No actual Ollama model inference or production matching consumer has been verified.
Provider/task settings remain in-process rather than persisted or user-configurable through a UI.
External application submission remains OFF; hosted evidence remains NOT_RUN.
